Messages.Author: pallando
Messages.Body:
i just wanted to check:
can the 2 bane mummy allies capable of playing necromancy cards at basic
(akhenaten and kherebutu) play basic summon soul to get 2 life?

i'd say yes because it says " If a card would give him blood, give him life"
on the cards.

can they also use basic shroud mastery to give a wraith +1 stealth? i'm not
sure because card text specifically refers to "a ready vampire". i would say
yes because it says "as a vampire" on the ally cards.

thanks in advance

pallando
